notes: Combo rules (docs/specs/universal-systems.md section 4). Percentages out of 10000; first guesses, to be tuned. Decay tables: [comboTimeFrames, percent] - once combo time reaches a row, hitstun (or untechable time) is scaled by that percent; the last row is techOutAt, where it drops to nothing. techOutAt = after this many frames of combo the fighter being hit can tech out no matter what: any button in hitstun (ground: the groundTech state; air: airTech). A move's own numbers override the defaults. repeatDamage / repeatHitstun = a move used again in the same combo does this share of its damage and hitstun. LAUNCHES: a move's 'launch' is "hard" (the S launchers: high, super-jump cancel on hit), "soft" (a short pop, jump cancel on hit), or { type, x, y } with its own speeds (px per frame; no type = soft; the older 'launcher: true' = hard). hardLaunch / softLaunch = the speeds a move gets when it names none. hardLaunchLimit = hard launches per combo; one more acts as a soft launch. JUGGLE: every hit on an airborne fighter adds its 'juggleCost' (default juggleCost) to the combo's total, and a soft launch adds softLaunchCost (or the move's own); once the total passes juggleLimit the fighter falls out: the hit still does its damage but gives no untechable time, no launch and no bounce. bounceLimit = wall bounces and ground bounces per combo, each.
